smash-karts.title: Play Smash Karts Online - Multiplayer Kart Battle Game
smash-karts.description: Smash Karts is a thrilling 3D multiplayer IO kart battle game. Drive your go-kart, pick up weapons, and blow up other karts to win! Keep playing to level up and unlock new characters and prizes. Join the action-packed Smash Karts universe today and experience the ultimate kart battle!
